caseName: Territory of Oklahoma ex rel. Ridings v. Neville
caseNameFull: Territory of Oklahoma upon the Relation of Ridings, County Attorney v. Neville, Board of County Commissioners
summary: Appeal from the Supreme Court of the Territory of Oklahoma.
attorneys: Mr. John W. Shartel and Mr. J. É. Keaton for the appellant. Mr. Horace Speed for the appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for-the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Smith v. Adams, 130 U. S. 167; Thomas v. Wooldridge, 23 Wall. 283, 288.
